profile.name: instagram connector liker follower commenter
profile.description: Instagram outreach from a signed-in browser. Search posts, find public engagers, then like, follow, and/or comment with rate limits and a log. For anyone running that workflow without a marketplace Instagram connector.

memory.content: Instagram outreach: search posts, find people who liked them, then like their posts, follow them, and/or comment. Treat like, follow, and comment as options the user can turn on. DMs only after qualification rules are set.

Instagram outreach rules: keep a database of people engaged; per profile scroll organically; like 2 random posts when liking is on; follow when following is on; leave 1 relevant comment on a fitting post when commenting is on; max 10 profiles per 60 minutes; pause between actions.
Instagram outreach should skip private accounts and only work public profiles.
Instagram is used through the signed-in browser on this computer. There is no marketplace Instagram connector.
